basic_details.job_title: IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Research Fellow/ Laboratory Assistant Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Engineering Science & Technology
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Engineering Science & Technology (IIEST Shibpur) Research Fellow / Laboratory Assistant Notification 2026 has been released on 22 July 2026 on the official website of Indian Institute of Engineering Science & Technology (IIEST Shibpur). A total of 2 vacancies have been announced through the IIEST Shibpur Research Fellow / Laboratory Assistant Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation is applicable: Upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and physically handicapped candidates.

qualification.education_qualification: M.Tech. or equivalent in Computer Science/Information Technology, B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. with national eligibility test qualification, Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, IT, Electronics
qualification.details: Research Fellow: M.Tech. or equivalent in Computer Science/Information Technology, or equivalent OR B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. with qualification in a national eligibility test (CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, etc.). Laboratory Assistant: Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related discipline.

salary_details.pay_scale: Research Fellow: Rs. 48,100/- per month (JRF) / Rs. 54,600/- per month (SRF) Laboratory Assistant: Rs. 35,100/- per month
salary_details.details: Research Fellow: Rs. 48,100/- per month (JRF) / Rs. 54,600/- per month (SRF) Laboratory Assistant: Rs. 35,100/- per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIEST Shibpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Research Fellow: M.Tech. or equivalent in Computer Science/Information Technology, or equivalent OR B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. with qualification in a national eligibility test (CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, etc.). Laboratory Assistant: Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related discipline.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIEST Shibpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 01-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Fellow and Laboratory Assistant posts is 01 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this IIEST Shibpur recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the positions of Research Fellow and Laboratory Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: For the Research Fellow position, candidates need an M.Tech. or equivalent in Computer Science/Information Technology, or a B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. with a national eligibility test qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIEST Shibpur posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Research Fellow and Laboratory Assistant posts is 35 years, with relaxations applicable for certain categories.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the IIEST Shibpur recruitment will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Laboratory Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Laboratory Assistant post will receive a salary of Rs. 35,100/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Interested candidates should apply by sending their complete application via email to the designated email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIEST Shibpur offer age relaxation for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Research Fellow and Laboratory Assistant are contractual in nature.
